content:
alex: Heads-up — new model bring-up request: `llamaX-13B` from partner repo. They want a cost-efficient quantized variant for inference. Can we decide a quant plan (int8 / fp8 / gguf) and a calibration checklist? latency SLO ~150ms p95, cost target ~= -40% vs fp16.

maria: Thanks alex. Quick Q — is the model FP16-native? any fused ops?

alex: FP16 weights. No unusual fused ops reported. Model has rotary embeddings and standard causal block.

devin: My quick take: start with int8 (dynamic/static) + activation calibration sweep. fp8 could be risky for stability but better density. gguf is more packaging (gguf quantized artifacts) — it's downstream of quant.

sara: Agree with devin. We should run a small smoke matrix: int8-dynamic, int8-static, fp8-e4m3, and a baseline gguf-int8 export. Evaluate quality on our regen prompt set and a small MMLU slice.

katy: +1. Also need to track perf: tokens/s and p95 latency on our 4090 and A100 configs. If p95 > 150ms for our typical 512-token requests, we need fallback plan.

alex: Proposed checklist (first pass):
- quick compatibility check (shapes, custom ops)
- export baseline fp16 run (perf/quality)
- run int8 dynamic quant (no calibration) smoke
- run int8 static with 1k calibration samples
- run fp8 (if supported) with 500 cal samples
- export gguf artifact for int8 variant and validate outputs
- run evals: regen prompts, MMLU 10-topic, STS subset, latency/cost measurements
- decide default serving variant and fallback policy

maria: Minor nit: calibration sample sources? use 500-1k from prod prompts (anonymized) + tokens variety (short/long). Also record token distribution.

devin: For calibration strategy: start with per-channel symmetric quant (SaW) and compare to asymmetric. Use KL divergence and cosine-sim on embeddings as quick checks. Also log weight scale histograms.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: please label experiments with `llamaX-13B/qplan/<variant>` and include docker image hash and commit.

katy: Measurement plan:
- quality: regen pass@1, token-level perplexity, BLEU for code prompts, and a delta-ROUGE for summarization prompts
- safety/regression: run our regression harness and check top-10 hallucination cases
- perf: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, memory peak, GPU util
- cost: simulated cost per 1M tokens on Dedicated (use current unit costs)

alex: Decision proposal: Run two parallel experiments:
1) int8-static w/ 1k cal + gguf export (primary candidate)
2) fp8-e4m3 w/ 500 cal (exploratory, only if runtime supports fp8 kernels)
Pick primary if quality delta < 2% regen-f1 and meets latency/cost SLOs.

sara: I can own the int8-static sweep and gguf export. Estimated wall time 6-8 hours on A100.

devin: I'll spin up fp8 exploratory on dev cluster, but mark it low-priority if we run into stability.

maria: I'll prepare the calibration dataset subset and the evaluation prompt set. Also will run a short sanity script to detect outlier tokens. Snippet: 
```
python tools/sample_calibration.py --source prod-logs --out cal/llamaX-1k.json --max-tokens 200000
```

katy: I'll set up perf harness and the dashboards. Tagging: @sara @devin for run start times.

alex: Nice. Final ask: add explicit rollback rules — if regen-F1 drops >3% or p95 increases >20% over baseline, automatic revert to fp16. Also ensure model pinning and canary rollout in Redwood console.

ops-bot: note: Canary rollout template `canary-quant` created. Use `rbac:eng-ml` to trigger.

devin: one more: save intermediate quantized artifacts and calibration metadata to /mnt/quant-artifacts/llamaX-13B/<variant>/<timestamp>.json. Include weight scale maps.

alex: Great — plan looks solid. Sara, please post results in this thread when the sweep completes. We'll reconvene to choose the default variant. :thumbsup:
